---
title: "About"
title-block-banner: true
---

This is a community-maintained and independent theme gallery for the Markdown presentation ecosystem [Marp](https://marp.app/). It is not affiliated with the official Marp project.

The goal of this project is to give users a curated selection of themes from various authors in the theming community. Feel free to provide any suggestions in the [issues tab](https://github.com/rnd195/marp-community-themes/issues) on GitHub.

This project is featured in the [Awesome Marp](https://github.com/marp-team/awesome-marp#themes) repository.

The theme gallery is currently being developed by [rnd195](https://github.com/rnd195/) and it’s built using [Quarto](https://quarto.org/).
